subject: HUP065
core_conclusion: Show every channel's recorded ictal, frozen free-prediction, unchanged patient-reference and cold-trained controlled occupation distributions, including channels that do not improve.
evidence_chain: All64 contacts are displayed in their original order; the empirical endpoint tables, not KDE appearance, determine improvement. A failed development experiment can only receive a clearly identified development preview.
statistical_scope: Ensemble/time-pooled descriptive model distributions; particles, contacts and time samples are not independent patient replicates. No confidence interval or hypothesis test is claimed.
